title: Greece and Rome on Film
description: Examines depictions of Greece and Rome in different eras and genres of film, including cartoons, Hollywood blockbusters, musical comedies and art films. Explores how film draws upon the myth, history and literary traditions of Greece and Rome, while also considering how depictions of the Greek and Roman world on screen reflect modern sensibilities and concerns.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of GRS 204, GRS 382.
